search.snippet: A bracelet mould allows a player to make bracelets through the Crafting skill out of gold bars and possibly gems by using them on a furnace. A minimum crafting level of 7 is needed to make bracelets. This is obtainable at any crafting store and Crafting Guild. It can also be obtained in your house if you have a tool store 4 in your workshop.
